# Personal Finance Tracker - Main Application Entrypoint
from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from typing import List
import os

from backend.routes import transactions, categories, auth

app = FastAPI(
    title="Personal Finance Tracker API",
    description="Production API generated by AI Product Architect for: Build a personal finance tracker with transactions, categories, budgets, monthly...",
    version="1.0.0"
)

app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["*"],
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)

app.include_router(transactions.router, prefix="/api/transactions", tags=["Transaction Management"])
app.include_router(categories.router, prefix="/api/categories", tags=["Category Management"])
app.include_router(auth.router, prefix="/api/auth", tags=["Authentication"])

@app.get("/health")
def health_check():
    return {"status": "healthy", "service": "Personal Finance Tracker", "version": "1.0.0"}

@app.get("/")
def root():
    return {"message": "Welcome to Personal Finance Tracker API", "docs_url": "/docs"}

# SQLAlchemy Models for Personal Finance Tracker
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Text, Float, Boolean, DateTime, ForeignKey
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, relationship
from datetime import datetime

Base = declarative_base()

class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    email = Column(String(255), nullable=False, unique=True, index=True)
    hashed_password = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    role = Column(String(50), nullable=False)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class Category(Base):
    __tablename__ = "categories"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    user_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    name = Column(String(100), nullable=False)
    type = Column(String(50), nullable=False)
    color = Column(String(30), nullable=False)

class Transaction(Base):
    __tablename__ = "transactions"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    user_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    category_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    amount = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    transaction_type = Column(String(50), nullable=False, index=True)
    description = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    date = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class Budget(Base):
    __tablename__ = "budgets"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    user_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    category_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    monthly_limit = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    current_spent = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    month_year = Column(String(20), nullable=False)

# Automated Integration Tests for Personal Finance Tracker
import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from backend.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_health():
    res = client.get("/health")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json()["status"] == "healthy"

def test_root():
    res = client.get("/")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "Welcome" in res.json()["message"]

def test_auth_flow():
    res = client.post("/api/auth/login", json={"email": "test@enterprise.io", "password": "SecretPassword123"})
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "access_token" in res.json()

def test_list_transactions():
    res = client.get("/api/transactions/")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert isinstance(res.json(), list)

def test_create_transaction():
    payload = {"title": "Automated Test Transaction", "name": "Automated Test Transaction", "description": "Verification Record", "priority": "high"}
    res = client.post("/api/transactions/", json=payload)
    assert res.status_code == 201
    data = res.json()
    assert data.get("title") == "Automated Test Transaction" or data.get("name") == "Automated Test Transaction"

def test_export_csv():
    res = client.get("/api/transactions/export-csv")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "text/csv" in res.headers["content-type"]

files.README.md:
# Personal Finance Tracker

Production cloud microservice generated by **AI Product Architect**.

## Domain Overview
- **Domain Category**: Personal Finance & Expense Tracker
- **Description**: Personal finance tracker managing transactions, monthly category budgets, and CSV export.
- **Primary Entity**: `Transaction`
- **Entities**: `User`, `Category`, `Transaction`, `Budget`

## Architecture Specification
- **Compute**: AWS ECS Fargate
- **Database**: PostgreSQL 15 RDS with Numeric Precisions
- **Cache**: None
- **Security**: JWT OAuth2 Bearer Tokens, Bcrypt Password Hashing, CORS Guards

## Architecture Topology
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  subgraph Client App
    WEB["Personal Finance Web Dashboard"]
    EXPORT["CSV Exporter Stream"]
  end

  subgraph API & Services
    ALB["Load Balancer"]
    API["Personal Finance Tracker Financial Core API"]
    BUDGET_ENG["Budget Tracking & Cap Engine"]
    CSV_GEN["CSV Streaming Serializer"]
  end

  subgraph Storage
    PG[("PostgreSQL (Transactions, Budgets, Categories)")]
  end

  WEB --> ALB --> API
  EXPORT --> ALB --> API
  API --> BUDGET_ENG
  API --> CSV_GEN
  BUDGET_ENG --> PG
  CSV_GEN --> PG
```

## Quick Start
```bash
# 1. Run local multi-container environment
docker-compose up --build

# 2. Check Service Health
curl http://localhost:8000/health
```

## API Documentation
- Interactive Swagger UI: `http://localhost:8000/docs`
- Live Deployment Preview: `http://localhost:8000/preview/personal-finance-tracker`
